blocks.orig: The Kuza Cave is an ancient jungle cave filled with crystal clear turquoise water that guarantees the most refreshing dive you might have ever experienced! The area around the cave is full of Zanzibar red colobus, colourful butterflies, birds and bush babies and the tour includes an explanation of the geological formation of the cave. A combination with a Swahili cooking lesson and lunch, a drumming and dancing lesson, or a Swahili history and music lesson is recommended at additional costs.
blocks.html: Kuza Cave is an ancient cave in the jungle, filled with crystal-clear turquoise water that promises what may be the most refreshing swim of your life! Around the cave you’ll find plenty of Zanzibar red colobus, colourful butterflies, birds and bush babies, and the tour includes an explanation of how the cave was formed geologically. We recommend combining it, at extra cost, with a Swahili cooking lesson and lunch, a drumming and dance lesson, or a lesson in Swahili history and music.
